name: United Acquisition Corp. I Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Operating as a shell company, United Acquisition Corp. I's core objective is to execute a strategic business combination. This encompasses a broad range of potential transactions, including but not limited to, mergers, share exchanges, asset or share acquisitions, recapitalizations, or reorganizations with other entities. The firm was inaugurated on October 22, 2025, and its corporate base is situated in Boca Raton, Florida.
